attacker_pocs.name: named-instance-axis-scratch
attacker_pocs.why: FT_Set_Named_Instance plus FT_Get_Advance on a valid 32-axis variable font copies normalized coordinates one past a 32-element stack buffer in tt_face_get_metrics (i <= n after n is capped at 32). Parent never enters this block for a named instance because it only applies HVAR/VVAR when FT_IS_VARIATION is set.

role_a_rationale: tt_face_get_metrics now applies HVAR/VVAR advance deltas when FT_IS_NAMED_INSTANCE is set, matching FT_IS_VARIATION, so FT_Get_Advance/FT_Get_Advances on a named instance return the adjusted advance (verified: base 1000 becomes 1200 at the max named instance, and the default instance stays 1000). The new named-instance path also copies normalized axis coordinates into a 32-slot stack buffer using an inclusive bound after clamping, which overflows on a face with 32 or more axes. That copy is skipped for pure variations and is a no-op for ordinary one-axis fonts, so normal named-instance queries stay correct. The same PoC exits 0 on the parent and aborts under ASan (rc 134) on the patched tree via FT_Get_Advance.
